name: Arcade Learning Environment (ALE)
title: The Arcade Learning Environment: An Evaluation Platform for General Agents

scope.zh: 面向通用智能体的 Atari 2600 游戏接口及评估方法。
scope.en: Atari 2600 interface and evaluation methodology for general agents.

limits.zh: 正式论文发表于 JAIR 2013，预印本始于 2012 年。跨游戏评估本身并不构成未见任务泛化协议；需明确游戏、动作重复次数及评测版本。
limits.en: JAIR 2013; first preprint 2012. Multi-game evaluation is not by itself a held-out generalization protocol; specify games, action repeat and evaluation version.

name: ViZDoom
title: ViZDoom: A Doom-based AI Research Platform for Visual Reinforcement Learning
venue: IEEE Conference on Computational Intelligence and Games (CIG), 2016

scope.zh: 可定制的 Doom 场景，提供视觉强化学习基线。
scope.en: Customizable Doom scenarios with visual RL baselines.

limits.zh: 属于研究平台，不对应唯一总分；死亡竞赛与导航任务应分别制定协议。
limits.en: A research platform rather than one fixed score; deathmatch and navigation require separate protocols.

name: SMAC
title: The StarCraft Multi-Agent Challenge

scope.zh: 原版合作式、去中心化多智能体微操场景。
scope.en: Original cooperative decentralized micromanagement scenarios.

limits.zh: 与 SMACv2 分开收录；不评估完整游戏的宏观经济、建造顺序或外交。
limits.en: Distinct from SMACv2; does not evaluate full-game macroeconomy, build orders or diplomacy.

name: SC2LE / PySC2
title: StarCraft II: A New Challenge for Reinforcement Learning

scope.zh: 支持《星际争霸 II》完整对局与小游戏的学习接口，并提供回放数据。
scope.en: StarCraft II full-game and minigame learning interface with replay data.

limits.zh: 完整对局与小游戏应分别报告；控制多个单位不自动构成去中心化多智能体强化学习。
limits.en: Full game and minigames must be reported separately; controlling many units does not automatically make the agent decentralized MARL.

name: TextWorld
title: TextWorld: A Learning Environment for Text-based Games

scope.zh: 支持手工编写和自动生成文字游戏的生成器与运行环境，包含原始 RL 评测任务集。
scope.en: Generator and runtime for handcrafted and generated text games; original RL benchmark set.

limits.zh: 基础 TextWorld 与 TextWorldExpress、TextWorld Commonsense 分开收录；需固定数据划分与任务设置。
limits.en: Base TextWorld is distinct from TextWorldExpress and TextWorld Commonsense; fixed split and task settings are needed.

name: BabyAI
title: BabyAI: A Platform to Study the Sample Efficiency of Grounded Language Learning

scope.zh: 面向高效语言学习的指令跟随网格世界关卡及启发式专家示范。
scope.en: Instruction-following gridworld levels and heuristic demonstrations for sample-efficient language learning.

limits.zh: 正式论文发表于 ICLR 2019，预印本始于 2018 年。合成语言的具身理解不意味着已提供原生 LLM 支持；默认观测为局部符号编码。
limits.en: ICLR 2019; first preprint 2018. Synthetic language grounding is not evidence of native LLM support; default observations are symbolic partial encodings.

name: OpenSpiel
title: OpenSpiel: A Framework for Reinforcement Learning in Games

scope.zh: 涵盖轮流行动、同时行动、合作与竞争博弈的游戏及算法框架。
scope.en: Game and algorithm framework spanning turn-taking, simultaneous, cooperative and competitive games.

limits.zh: 没有唯一通用评测总分；需明确游戏规则、对手以及可利用度或回报指标。所列游戏为已核验示例，并非完整游戏列表。
limits.en: No single canonical benchmark score; game rules, opponents and exploitability/return metrics must be specified. Games listed are verified examples, not exhaustive.

name: DeepMind Lab
title: DeepMind Lab
games: DeepMind Lab 3D navigation and puzzle tasks

scope.zh: 基于 Quake III 引擎、可配置的三维导航与解谜任务平台。
scope.en: Configurable 3D navigation and puzzle task platform built on the Quake III engine.

limits.zh: 使用第一人称射击游戏引擎，不意味着所有任务都是射击评测；记忆与泛化研究需落实到具体关卡与协议。
limits.en: Using an FPS engine does not make every task a shooter benchmark. Memory and generalization depend on the chosen level and protocol.

name: GVGAI
title: General Video Game AI: a Multi-Track Framework for Evaluating Agents, Games and Content Generation Algorithms

scope.zh: 面向电子游戏游玩、学习及程序化内容生成的多赛道框架。
scope.en: Multi-track framework for video-game playing, learning and procedural generation.

limits.zh: 平台始于 2014 年，所引综述首次发表于 2018 年预印本。与 GVGAI-LLM 分开收录；不同赛道的条件和前向模拟访问权限不同。
limits.en: Platform dates to 2014; cited overview first appeared in 2018. Distinct from GVGAI-LLM. Track conditions and simulation access differ.

name: CoinRun
title: Quantifying Generalization in Reinforcement Learning

scope.zh: 面向强化学习泛化评估的原版 CoinRun 基准。
scope.en: Original CoinRun benchmark for generalization in RL.

limits.zh: 正式论文发表于 ICML 2019，预印本始于 2018 年。原版 CoinRun 与 Procgen CoinRun 的协议不可混用；仓库已归档，本次未验证实际运行。 官方测试采样不保证排除训练关卡；严格不重叠评测需另行核验。
limits.en: ICML 2019; preprint 2018. Do not merge original CoinRun and Procgen CoinRun protocols. Repository is archived; runtime not verified. Official test sampling does not guarantee exclusion of training levels; strictly disjoint evaluation requires verification.

name: Obstacle Tower
title: Obstacle Tower: A Generalization Challenge in Vision, Control, and Planning

scope.zh: 程序化生成的第三人称三维高塔评测环境，包含强化学习与人类基线。
scope.en: Procedurally generated third-person 3D tower benchmark with RL and human baselines.

limits.zh: 需报告随机种子划分、视觉主题与环境版本；原始基准与比赛设置可能不同。
limits.en: Report seed split, visual theme and environment version; original benchmark and challenge settings may differ.

name: MineRL dataset
title: MineRL: A Large-Scale Dataset of Minecraft Demonstrations

scope.zh: 与模拟器配套的人类示范数据，用于研究 Minecraft 中的样本高效学习。
scope.en: Simulator-paired human demonstrations for sample-efficient Minecraft learning.

limits.zh: 本条为数据集，并非完整评测协议；应区分原始数据发布、ObtainDiamond 比赛与 BASALT 模糊目标任务。
limits.en: Dataset entry, not a complete benchmark protocol. Distinguish dataset release from ObtainDiamond competition and BASALT fuzzy-goal tasks.

name: Griddly
title: Griddly: A platform for AI research in games

scope.zh: 可配置的游戏引擎，支持单智能体、多智能体及即时战略环境接口。
scope.en: Configurable game engine with single-agent, multi-agent and RTS interfaces.

limits.zh: 本条年份对应 2020 年预印本，与 GriddlyJS 网页开发环境分开收录。YAML 游戏引擎本身不对应唯一标准评测或单一游戏类型。
limits.en: 2020 preprint; distinct from GriddlyJS web IDE. A YAML engine does not imply one standardized benchmark or one genre.

name: ELF / MiniRTS
title: ELF: An Extensive, Lightweight and Flexible Research Platform for Real-time Strategy Games

scope.zh: 提供 MiniRTS、夺旗与塔防环境的即时战略引擎及强化学习平台。
scope.en: RTS engine and RL platform with MiniRTS, Capture the Flag and Tower Defense.

limits.zh: MiniRTS 是自定义的简化游戏，并非《星际争霸 II》。即时战略分类对应原论文环境，不扩展至后续 ELF 围棋或 ALE 集成。
limits.en: MiniRTS is a miniature custom game, not StarCraft II. RTS-specific mapping applies to paper environments, not later ELF Go or ALE integrations.

name: Project Malmo
title: The Malmo Platform for Artificial Intelligence Experimentation

scope.zh: Minecraft 实验平台，提供可配置任务及智能体观测、动作接口。
scope.en: Minecraft experimentation platform with configurable missions and agent observation/action interfaces.

limits.zh: 平台可支持某项能力研究，不等于已定义固定评测协议；需明确任务、奖励、观测及多智能体配置。
limits.en: Platform capability does not establish a fixed assessment protocol. Specify mission, reward, observations and multi-agent setup.

name: SpireBench
title: SpireBench: Evaluating Long-Horizon Strategic Play of Agentic Models with Slay the Spire

scope.zh: 在原版《杀戮尖塔》中完成整局决策，以术语重命名和记忆消融区分先验知识与长期策略。
scope.en: Full-run decisions in the original Slay the Spire, with renamed game terminology and memory ablations.

metrics.zh: 分幕通关率、完成幕数、终止楼层、每局与每层成本。
metrics.en: Act win rates, acts cleared, final floor, cost per run and floor.

limits.zh: A20、Ironclad 与十个固定测试种子的结果不能直接推广到全部角色；未核实官方代码仓库。
limits.en: A20 Ironclad results on ten test seeds do not establish performance across every character; official repository not verified.

name: PokéAgent Challenge
title: The PokeAgent Challenge: Competitive and Long-Context Learning at Scale

scope.zh: 战斗赛道测试宝可梦不完全信息对战；速通赛道测试 Pokémon Emerald 的长期推进。
scope.en: Competitive battling tests imperfect-information Pokémon play; speedrunning tests long-horizon progress in Pokémon Emerald.

metrics.zh: 当前战斗官网主指标为 FH-BT 技能评分；速通采用里程碑、耗时和动作数。
metrics.en: Current battle leaderboard: FH-BT skill rating. Speedrunning: milestones, time and action count.

limits.zh: 固定规则、计时器、状态访问和脚手架后比较；2025 速通竞赛只评到首个道馆。
limits.en: Match ruleset, timers, state access and scaffolding; the 2025 speedrun competition evaluated only the first gym.

name: VGC-Bench
title: VGC-Bench: Towards Mastering Diverse Team Strategies in Competitive Pokémon

scope.zh: 在 VGC 双打中检验智能体使用不同阵容的能力，提供 RL、行为克隆、LLM 与启发式基线。
scope.en: Evaluates piloting diverse VGC doubles teams with RL, behavior-cloning, LLM and heuristic baselines.

metrics.zh: 交叉对战胜率、Alpha-Rank、未见阵容泛化、训练对手得到的可利用性估计。
metrics.en: Cross-play win rates, Alpha-Rank, unseen-team generalization and trained-exploiter estimates.

limits.zh: 研究已有阵容的使用而非完整构筑；LLM 基线较基础，评测局数少于 RL。
limits.en: Studies team usage rather than full team construction; the basic LLM baseline has fewer evaluation games than RL.

name: gg-bench
title: Measuring General Intelligence with Generated Games

scope.zh: 自动生成新游戏并训练 RL 对手，用游戏说明、棋盘状态和合法动作评测 LLM 下棋。
scope.en: Generates novel games and RL opponents; LLMs play from rules, board state and legal actions.

metrics.zh: 对 RL 对手的平均胜率、成本及失败类型。
metrics.en: Average win rate against RL opponents, cost and failure categories.

limits.zh: 生成规则与实现可能不一致；胜率依赖对手强度。属于游戏对战评测，不是游戏开发质量评测。
limits.en: Generated rules and implementations may disagree; win rate depends on opponent strength. This evaluates gameplay, not game-development quality.

name: COMRAD
title: COMRAD: A Benchmark for Embodied Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
venue: Nineteenth European Workshop on Reinforcement Learning (project citation)

scope.zh: 13 个第一人称合作场景，以局部视觉、角色差异、同步行为与程序化地图研究 MARL。
scope.en: Thirteen first-person cooperative scenarios combine local vision, asymmetric roles, synchronization and generated layouts.

metrics.zh: 场景原始得分与归一化得分、留出地图表现、学习曲线及多种子置信区间。
metrics.en: Scenario raw/normalized scores, held-out-layout performance, learning curves and multi-seed confidence intervals.

limits.zh: 官方基线是 RL；未核实原生 LLM 接口。OpenReview 正文受浏览器验证限制，论文身份来自官方项目页。
limits.en: Official baselines are RL; native LLM support is unverified. OpenReview access was challenged; identity comes from the authors' project page.

name: AgenticSTS
title: AgenticSTS: A Bounded-Memory Testbed for Long-Horizon LLM Agents

scope.zh: 将每步上下文拆为可消融的有界记忆层，在《杀戮尖塔 2》中研究长期决策，发布 298 条轨迹。
scope.en: Ablatable bounded memory layers support long-horizon decisions in Slay the Spire 2; 298 trajectories are released.

metrics.zh: 固定难度胜率及置信区间、进度与难度阶梯结果、token 和成本。
metrics.en: Fixed-difficulty win rates with confidence intervals, progress/difficulty-ladder results, tokens and cost.

limits.zh: 关键 A0 消融每条件十局，差异未达统计决定性；跨脚手架比较不是严格受控的记忆因果检验。
limits.en: Key A0 cells have ten runs and inconclusive differences; cross-harness comparisons do not isolate memory causally.

name: DareFightingICE LLM AI Competition 2026
title: 2026 DareFightingICE LLM AI Competition

scope.zh: 面向实时格斗的 LLM 竞赛，限定提示工程或最多 7B 模型微调。
scope.en: A real-time fighting competition using prompt engineering or fine-tuned LLMs up to 7B parameters.

metrics.zh: 2026 完整计分规则待补充，不能沿用网站旧版 2013–2021 规则。
metrics.en: Full 2026 scoring protocol remains unverified; do not reuse legacy 2013–2021 rules.

limits.zh: 竞赛身份和结果已核实，2026 规则包链接未成功读取；作为协议待补充条目。
limits.en: Competition identity/results are verified, but the 2026 rule-package link failed; protocol details are pending.

verificationDetail.zh: 仅核实 2026 竞赛身份和官方结果；当届计分协议尚待核验。
verificationDetail.en: Only the 2026 competition identity and official results were checked; its scoring protocol remains unverified.
